title: Select authoring guidance after a profile change
actor: An author resuming model work under a different declared profile version
goal: Identify the guidance that applies to the selected profile and avoid relying on obsolete authoring rules.
context: The author has previously used guidance whose applicability may differ from the profile now selected for the project.
trigger: The author resumes an activity after the profile selection changes.
preconditions: The selected profile version and requested activity are identifiable.

interaction.action: Identifies the selected profile and requests guidance for the resumed activity.
Presents applicable canonical sources and distinguishes previously used guidance that is superseded, incompatible, or unavailable.
Requests an explanation of the rule relevant to the intended edit.
Explains the selected rule and any required profile or representation decision that remains unresolved.

expected_outcome: The author can identify applicable guidance and its versions without mistaking guidance selection for migration, approval, or support for an undeclared format.

alternatives.outcome: The system identifies the matching scope and applicable version basis.

failures.condition: The selected version has no available authoritative guidance.
failures.outcome: The system reports the unsupported scope instead of silently substituting another version.

failures.condition: Two sources conflict for the selected activity.
failures.outcome: The system identifies the conflict and prevents a false claim that the authoring rule is settled.

sources.basis: Analyzes IR-006 through a distinct stakeholder goal within the selected initial authoring profile; the owning IR records Scenario ownership. Accepted as current requirement-analysis knowledge after independent coverage and clarity review: one owning IR and primary Feature, observable goal and interactions, classified outcomes, and applicable SR coverage. This confirms analysis only, not requirement approval, implementation, or satisfaction.
